# openinfra_table (Resource)

A DynamoDB-shaped key/value table — the DynamoDB-equivalent primitive. Registers a table's name and (immutable) key schema on the aws-shim's DynamoDB data layer so items are writable without a runtime CreateTable. A thin front onto a data-plane capability: it functions only where the aws-shim DynamoDB front door is enabled (opt-in), and does not provision capacity, secondary indexes, or streams — reach for `openinfra_database` when you need those.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hash_key` (Attributes) The partition (HASH) key. Immutable, as in DynamoDB. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hash_key))
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `billing_mode` (String) Advisory only — the FerretDB-backed store has no capacity model. `PAY_PER_REQUEST` (default) or `PROVISIONED`.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `range_key` (Attributes) The optional sort (RANGE) key. Immutable, as in DynamoDB. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--range_key))
- `table_name` (String) The DynamoDB table name clients address. Defaults to the resource name. Immutable.
- `ttl_attribute` (String) Optional. Enables Time-To-Live on this numeric (epoch-seconds) attribute; the shim's reaper deletes items whose value is at or before now.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.

<a id="nestedatt--hash_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hash_key`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name of the partition key.
- `type` (String) Scalar key type: `S` (string), `N` (number), or `B` (binary).


<a id="nestedatt--range_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `range_key`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name of the sort key.
- `type` (String) Scalar key type: `S`, `N`, or `B`.
